title: Eric Hecker's childhood involvement with the Stargate program

tellings.quote: >> I grew up on Long Island. Um I had a very peculiar history uh of nefarious activity with uh the Stargate program.

plain: A man named Eric Hecker says that as a child growing up on Long Island, New York, he was caught up in Stargate, the US government's secret programme for psychic spying. He tells it himself, describing it only as "a very peculiar history of nefarious activity" with the programme, on an episode about secret elite networks.
